title: Tier 2 research track charter (no compute spend in M0)
summary: Write the charter for the funded Tier 2 research track so its first prototype can start in M1 with an approved monthly budget: goals, SPEC §5 metrics with measurement procedures, the standing-ticket and report formats, and the reading list.

acceptance_tests.test: research/tier2/README.md restates SPEC §5 metrics R1–R6 with a concrete measurement procedure for each (corpus subset, device, duration, tester count).

Standing-ticket format (M<n>-RES-01), monthly compute AUTH REQUEST template (spend; H100/A100 hourly; estimated hours), and the checkpoint report template (per-scan compute cost, mobile frame-time table, plausibility results) are included.
Reading list covers Gaussian Grouping lineage, VR-GS, DecoupledGaussian, tet-embedded Gaussians, XPBD, and 2026 scene-level physics papers, each with a one-line relevance note.
An M1 prototype plan with an expected cost estimate is stated; no compute is spent in M0 (statement in the file).
